source: athletic.net meet pages + OHSAA 2026 district/regional representation documents (compiled by Podium Watch)

rule.teams: Top N teams by team place advance; all 7 rostered varsity runners on a qualifying team advance.
rule.individuals: Then the first 2N finishers (by place) who are NOT on a qualifying team advance. Runners from incomplete teams count as individuals.
rule.d1: Division I has no district meets in 2026; D1 schools enter regionals directly.

northeast_note: Northeast per-site N is announced Oct 20, 2026; teams_advance/individuals_advance are null until then. Region totals are known.
